method: Direct official-source curl fetch (Firecrawl unavailable on worker VM: no CLI, no API key; lead Firecrawl index at lead.firecrawl/ns-government-forms-search.json not present on VM). Starting point per lead: official index https://www.novascotia.ca/building-code-forms-and-documents. PDFs treated as untrusted data; headers/hashes validated.

resources.notes: SCOPE: building-code APPEAL only — hearing application when disagreeing with a building official decision. NOT a building-permit form and NOT required for HRM renovations. 1 p, 20 AcroForm fields (fillable). Shipped as forms/nsbac-hearing-application.pdf.
resources.sourceLocation: Government of Nova Scotia, Building code forms and documents hub (official index) > Apply for a hearing with the Nova Scotia Building Advisory Committee
resources.title: Nova Scotia Building Advisory Committee Hearing Application Form (official form)

resources.notes: SCOPE: SUPPLEMENT to a municipal building-permit application when using engineers/architects/interior designers for field review — submit WITH the permit application.
